svg.title: About Infinity X
svg.desc: Two columns. The left lists four areas of focus. The right cycles three interest panels every four seconds.
svg.text: Defensive security and how systems are reviewed.
Web and backend software, built with care.
Machine learning where it helps a product.
Forensics and threat analysis, as study.

g.text: Interested in how attacks are understood
so defenses can be designed. Not a claim
service. Learning, not a lab credential.
Interested in how incidents are reconstructed
and how public threat information is read
without pretending to hold a case load.
